LanguageData.LP_DemonBloodRush.label: demon blood
LanguageData.LP_DemonBloodRush.description: Demon blood burns in the veins: +15% melee damage, -10% pain.
LanguageData.LP_DemonBloodDrawn.label: demon blood drawn
LanguageData.LP_DemonBloodDrawn.description: Had blood drawn recently; cannot be drawn again for 5 days.
LanguageData.LP_FangWearer.label: wearing a soul-gorged fang
LanguageData.LP_FangWearer.description: The fang presses against the skin as if whispering for more souls: each humanlike kill adds a stack of damage bonus; abyssal taint +0.2% per day.
LanguageData.LP_FangGorged.label: soul-gorged fang
LanguageData.LP_FangGorged.description: The fang stores the souls of the slain: +1% damage per stack, up to 10 stacks, cleared on death.
